chunking.method: paragraphs (newline-split) packed into chunks of >= 1200 chars
chunking.oversize_chunks: split to <= 254 tokens with 32 token overlap

notes: Vector IDs are sequential and equal the 'id' field in documents.jsonl.
document_offsets.bin holds one little-endian uint64 byte offset per document ID.
Embeddings are L2-normalized; inner product == cosine similarity.
